question: In a certain code language, 'STEM' is written as `VXHQ', and 'ROOT' is written as `USRX'. How will 'SEED' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daaccc2a87fc8c6f37a52789d74be3bec746d749cecd4822ad6f7369546fee68.png] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5d6a3b6f30ae57c8582f447c7fcdbbb20b4384492ff63f7c17afd4d83777b11.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1ebf7fb7bf62f287bf81d3ce00935ab57181e91b4ccd521e77d82d24bb0a551.png] 

Hence, ‘**VIHH**’ is the correct answer.
